description: Review of wave 1 (spec defk-jlk): 'Float reductions that would need reordering to vectorise stay in order (document as a limit if it costs)'. jlk measured no cost (dot ~0.56 ns/elem, sum 0.50-0.53, mean_var 3.8-4.3 with and without the flag) but recorded it only in its report. Add a README note: reductions are kept in order (no fast-math/reassociation), measured cost of the flag ~0, and that unordered vectorised float reductions are not done (a limit).
title: Record in-order float reduction cost of -ffp-contract=off
